info.title: ShipmentDocumentManagement
info.description:
Document management of shipment related documents.

This v2 API is considered legacy and is intended for existing integrations only.
Its functionality is limited to adding documents and downloading documents.
Please use v3 of this API for new integrations.

get.description: Returns all documents matching the parameters passed as request input payload.

parameters.name: referenceType
parameters.description:
One of the references to search for.

Supported reference types:
* TRACKING_NUMBER
* SHIPMENT_ID

parameters.name: documentCode
parameters.description: Code of a document type according to the Kuehne+Nagel specific classification.

200.description: Return pdf if only one document found, zip otherwise.

post.description:
Add a document to a specific shipment.

Before the document is actually added to the shipment the uploaded content must pass a
security scan and conversion to [PDF/A](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDF/A). This is done asynchronously
and usually only takes a couple of seconds. For the future it is planned to immediately scan and convert the document.

201.description:
Request to add a document to the shipment was created.

The status of the request can be retrieved using the returned link.

get.description: Retrieve meta data of a specific shipment document.
Retrieve the document types that can be used to add a document to the specific shipment.

200.description: Set of document types that can be used to add a document to the specific shipment.

documentContent.description:
Content of the document (preferably a PDF) that should be added to the shipment.

Must have
* a size of max. 10 MB
* a supported file extension
  * pdf
  * docx/doc
  * xlsx/xls
  * png
  * jpeg/jpg
  * tiff/tif
  * rtf
  * bmp
* in case of a PDF: no read protection

AddDocumentRequest.description: Request body for adding a document to a shipment.

self.description: URI to retrieve the meta data of the uploaded shipment document.

AddDocumentResponse.description: Response returned after a document upload request has been created.

DocumentId.description: Unique identifier of a shipment document.

DocumentType.description: Kuehne+Nagel specific classification of shipment documents.

DocumentTypeCode.description:
Code of a document type according to the Kuehne+Nagel specific classification.

The document types allowed for uploading a document can be retrieved via the operation `/shipments/{uniqueShipmentReference}/uploadable-document-types`.

Often uploaded document types:
* 380 (Commercial Invoice)
* 271 (Packing List)
* 944 (Customs Documents)
* 833 (Export Declaration)

DocumentTypeName.description: Name of a document type according to the Kuehne+Nagel specific classification.

detail.description: A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem that is helpful to locate the problem and give advice on how to proceed. Written in English and readable for engineers, usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem, e.g. by adding a fragment identifier or sub-path to the problem type. May be used to locate the root of this problem in the source code.

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type. Written in English and readable for engineers, usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized.

type.description: A URI reference that uniquely identifies the problem type only in the context of the provided API. Opposed to the specification in RFC-7807, it is neither recommended to be dereferencable and point to a human-readable documentation nor globally unique for the problem type.

Problem.description: A problem details object as defined by RFC 7807, used to carry error information in HTTP API responses.

RetrieveDocumentDetailsResponse.description: Response containing the detailed metadata of a specific shipment document.

uploadableDocumentTypes.description: List of document types available for uploading to the shipment.

RetrieveUploadableDocumentTypesResponse.description: Response containing the document types that can be uploaded for a specific shipment.

default.description: An error occurred - please see the HTTP status code and the problem object for more information.

uniqueShipmentReferenceParameter.name: uniqueShipmentReference
uniqueShipmentReferenceParameter.description:
By default this is the shipment __tracking number__ e.g. `N4242`.

In case a tracking number is not available a limited set of alternative references can be used.
Please use the track and trace API to first search for shipment details (e.g. by a customer specific reference)
if none of the supported references are available .

Supported references:
* __tracking number__
  * `{trackingNumber}` or `tracking-number:{trackingNumber}`
  * e.g. `N4242` or `tracking-number:N4242`
* __booking number__
  * `booking-number:{bookingNumber}`
  * e.g. `booking-number:B1`
* __shipment id__
  * `shipment-id:{shipmentId}`
  * e.g. `shipment-id:S1`
